Card Deck stochastic layer (Judgment shortcut, Cull crit-amp, Royal card-draw) has no direct engine analog — the variance modifier layer is noted but not emitted as a mechanic token (no mint candidate; it compresses into the mark-consume burst-damage consequence). Ruin/Celestial/Emperor/Royal/Chancellor are all proper names — zero element or ailment attestation. Self-buff stack (Move Speed/Crit Rate/Crit Damage per Ruin stack) maps as an economy self-buff rider on the stack accumulation, not a separate ailment. GX-03 gap_ref noted (mark/detonate family). payload.summary: Stack 4 Ruin marks via Stacking Skills (Spiral Edge, Scratch Dealer, Call of Destiny, Lightstream), then detonate with Ruin Skills (Celestial Rain, Secret Garden, Four of a Kind, Serendipity, The Devil). Card Deck draws between stacks; hold up to 2 cards simultaneously. Key cards: Judgment (all Ruin skills act as 4-stack hit), Royal (draws 2 cards), Cull (+100% Crit Rate +50% Crit Damage for 4s), Clown (redraws last card). Burst loop is build-spend with stochastic card variance.
